about: Per resolve class, the largest difference in any channel (0-255) a backend's pixel may show against the reference pixel of that class (the core's own CPU frames). All are placeholders until the cross-architecture measurement sets them. Coverage is a placeholder of 2, not derived: the CPU path's own coverage resolve lands within 3 of its sample resolve for a pixel with one partial mask of one colour under at most one translucent layer (COVERAGE_TO_SAMPLE_LSB), and within the larger bound coverage_to_sample_bound derives for wider stacks (a path's partial area, a surface's masks in several colours, more layers in front), so a backend that resolves coverage-class pixels by sampling needs at least that.
